purpose: Synthetic correctness and finite-pool query efficiency, not real sprite accuracy or productivity

queryComparison.pool: 3 original crafted fixtures and random seeds 1000..1028
queryComparison.success: all remaining programs predict the same outputs on the entire 32-grid pool; does not imply global equivalence
queryComparison.censoring: unsolved runs reported separately; mean queries is capped at 6, not an uncensored convergence estimate

noSolution.cases: contradictory pair; empty grid to isolated new pixel (outside grammar)
noSolution.expected: zero candidates and no sure output

gates: all inferred candidates fit every supplied example
every withheld consensus equals target output
contradictions and known out-of-grammar evidence yield zero candidates
claimsExcluded: out-of-grammar detection when evidence also fits an in-grammar program
